events.title: FIDO launches a Payments Working Group
events.detail: Co-chaired by Visa and Mastercard; the group AP2 later moved to.

events.title: AP2 repository created
events.detail: google-agentic-commerce/AP2 on GitHub.

events.title: AP2 announced, v0.1.0 released
events.detail: Google said it was working with more than 60 organizations on agentic payments and named 16; Intent, Cart and Payment Mandates; a2a-x402 launched alongside.

events.title: Google Cloud and PayPal announce an AP2 checkout agent
events.detail: A PayPal Agent in line with AP2 is to handle checkout over A2A for merchants; an announcement, not evidence of production use.

events.title: Tether, Solana and OKX join the partners page
a2a-x402 v0.2 adds the Embedded Flow
events.detail: Nests x402 objects inside AP2 v0.1 CartMandate and PaymentMandate.

events.title: x402 payments in the AP2 Python samples
UCP ships with an AP2 mandates extension
events.detail: Named dev.ucp.shopping.ap2_mandate at first.

events.title: Prompt-injection red team of AP2
events.detail: arXiv:2601.22569, Branded Whisper and Vault Whisper.

events.title: Replay and context-binding analysis
events.detail: arXiv:2602.06345 proposes consume-once runtime nonces.

events.title: Delegate SD-JWT posted to the IETF
events.detail: draft-gco-oauth-delegate-sd-jwt-00, the chaining mechanism of v0.2.

events.title: v0.2.0 released and AP2 donated to FIDO
events.detail: Open and closed Checkout and Payment Mandates; Intent and Cart removed; Verifiable Intent donated the same day.

events.title: Last commit on main
events.detail: No commit merged afterwards as of 2026-11-21.

events.title: Google plans AP2 in its products
events.detail: Starting with Gemini Spark, in the coming months. Google's help center later says Spark was renamed Task.

events.title: Issue 268 opened
events.detail: Contradiction on deterministic signatures for the Checkout JWT; deferred to FIDO on 2026-05-27.

events.title: Protocol-level attack study names AP2 v0.2.0
events.detail: arXiv:2607.21824 reports 14 AP2 vulnerabilities proven by code against the reference implementation.

events.title: Beyond the Mandate security analysis
events.detail: 48 threats to v0.2, eight High.

events.title: UCP renames the extension and aligns with v0.2
events.detail: dev.ucp.common.payment.ap2_mandate in release v2026-08-25.

events.title: draft-stone-vcap-ap2-binding-01
events.detail: Third-party individual Internet-Draft; still names v0.1 objects.

events.title: FIDO presents AP2 and Verifiable Intent targets
events.detail: At a W3C and GS1 workshop the Payments Technical Working Group targeted harmonized specifications by the end of 2026 and a first consolidated version in mid-2027; stated targets, not deliverables.

events.title: Whisper attacks and A-VIP defense
TypeScript SDK pull request closed unmerged
Approval-path attacks tested against AP2
events.detail: arXiv:2610.21063: five of its twelve approval-path attacks apply to v0.2.0; the constraint layer rejected every executed binding attack.

events.title: Council adopts its first-reading positions on PSD3 and the Payment Services Regulation
events.detail: First-reading positions on both files, with no provisions on AI agents; the European Parliament's second reading is indicatively set for the plenary of 2026-12-14.

events.title: IETF OAuth working group adopts Delegate SD-JWT
events.detail: draft-ietf-oauth-delegate-sd-jwt-00 replaces the individual draft that AP2 v0.2 cites for chaining mandates; it renames the KB-SD-JWT+KB typ to kb-sd-jwt+kb.

events.title: Issue 398: constraints can slip between roles in the samples
events.detail: Third-party report on the v0.2 Python samples: undisclosed Payment-side constraints, mixed mandate pairs and budget counters kept only by the agent; not reproduced by the atlas.

events.title: Google says Gemini now uses AP2 for purchases
events.detail: Checkout with Google Pay in Tasks in Gemini (formerly Spark), rolling out to US users aged 18 and over in English on web, Android and iOS. Google names Mastercard and Visa, with American Express coming soon, for digital tokens, and publishes no AP2 version, mandate types, signer or verifier. Google's statement, not technical evidence.

events.title: Issue 399: the Python SDK compares checkout_hash only on request
events.detail: CheckoutMandateChain.verify() checks checkout_hash only when the caller passes expected_checkout_hash; a third-party fix (PR 400) was open and unmerged on 2026-11-21. No advisory or CVE.
